thread:
Marta: quick async — what I did / blockers / today

Marta: did: pushed edge-proxy config v2 (routing weights + rate windows), ran local smoke for auth handshake.
Marta: blocker: staging JWT rotation still flakes on long-lived connections, seeing 401s after ~4m. need someone to pair on reproducer.
Marta: today: pair with Li on JWT repro, then land the route-weight-smoothing PR if green, and monitor canary burst behaviour.

Sam: saw the canary lit up, i'll kick off a 30m soak for high-QPS flows. will watch 429s.
Sam: quick check: new rate window is 120req/min by default for /v1/generate, right?

Li: correct on default, but the token bucket math changed slightly — limits are now per-route+identity. that's probably why some clients hit early.
Li: blocker: i can't reproduce JWT rotation locally; staging logs show: `auth: token_refresh failed: invalid_kid` intermittently.
Li: can someone share a curl that reproduces the long-poll behaviour?

Jordan: i'll take the PR review for route-weight-smoothing. left one comment about fallback ordering. should be quick.
Jordan: also +1 on adding a short circuit-breaker to route->auth to fallback to legacy-auth for 10s if upstream fails. e.g.
```
circuit_breaker:
  threshold: 5
  window: 10s
  fallback: legacy-auth
```

Nora: ops note: we have spare capacity in us-west-2 tonight, canary can be bumped from 10% -> 30% after soak if no 5xx/429 spikes.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for edge-proxy-v2 -> traffic=10% (us-west-2). link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/deploys/edgex-1023

ops-bot: alert config updated: rate-anomaly -> paging suppressed during scheduled canary windows.

Sam: repro curl for long-poll (try from staging):
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Client-ID: test-qps" \
  "https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?stream=true&route=edge-proxy"
```

Li: thanks, trying now. will attach logs if i get the `invalid_kid` again.

Marta: temporary mitigation: lower jwt refresh overlap to 30s and add extra retry on auth handshake. config snippet:
```
auth:
  jwt:
    refresh_overlap: 30s
    retry: 2
```

Sam: running soak. will report 429/latency hist in 30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Jordan: landed a small PR to add the cb fallback config; will open rollback PR if we observe regressions.

Nora: if Li can't reproduce by EOD, ops can run a targeted trace on a failing connection id — ping me.

Li: reproduced locally with the curl above, collecting debug logs now. will post snippets.

Marta: thanks all. i'll coordinate post-soak metrics and decide on bump to 30%. ping me for pairing on the jwt traces. :thumbsup:

Sam: ack.

deploy-bot: canary progress: 10% -> 10% (stable for 8m), no errors above threshold.

Marta: end of async update.
